title: Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to Traffic Loops Crackfilling Inc.: Covering on-call installation and maintenance of traffic loop detectors at Los Angeles International Airport and V
text:
[CONSENT ITEMS FOR BOARD ACTION [Consent Items 1 - 10]]
RESOLUTION NO. - Adoption of the staff report; and Approval of the Award of a five (5)-year Contract to Traffic Loops Crackfilling Inc.: Covering on-call installation and maintenance of traffic loop detectors at Los Angeles International Airport and Van Nuys Airport, for cost not to exceed $750,000 (Daniel Hughes)
summary: Awards a five-year on-call contract to Traffic Loops Crackfilling for installing and maintaining traffic loop detectors at LAX and Van Nuys Airport, capped at $750,000.

locations.text: Los Angeles International Airport, Los Angeles, CA
Van Nuys Airport, Van Nuys, CA
